item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Vernacular inscriptions from the Venetan area (13th-15th centuries): survey, critical edition and linguistic analysis (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-31 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/LIFI-01 Linguistica e filologia italiana

The research activity includes reviewing literature on Northern Italo-Romance vernacular inscriptions, specifically Venetan varieties, from the 13th to 15th centuries, conducting in situ surveys, managing data entry and cataloguing, as well as producing the scientific edition and linguistic commentary of the collected texts. The research is carried out within the framework of the FIS 3 project INCIDO - INscriptions in the Context of early Italian linguistic DOcumentation.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Development of a database and annotated digital editions of Renaissance comedies representing Roma, Ottomans, and Moors (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-31 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/PEMM-01 Arti performative, musicali, cinematografiche e mediali

The research will be carried out within the framework of the FIS3 StOIRC project, which focuses on the analysis of representations of Roma, Ottomans, and “Moors” in Italian Renaissance comedy (c. 1500–1650) and in adaptations of theatrical texts produced in various languages of Western Europe. The main activities will include: Co-designing a database aimed at identifying the theatrical texts included in the corpus and classifying bibliographic and textual information relevant to the objectives of the project. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Digital Poliglopolis: mapping migrant Spanish as linguistic and cultural heritage in urban areas (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-29 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/SPAN-01 Lingue, letterature e culture spagnola e ispano-americane

The project stems from well-established expertise in the Spanish-speaking linguistic landscape and requires a dedicated research contract to ensure scientific continuity, methodological rigour and operational capacity in the development of the Poliglopolis platform as a permanent digital observatory. The complexity of the work – expanding the survey areas, validating data, conducting comparative analysis, engaging with local communities and disseminating the results – makes it necessary to have a dedicated person responsible for coordinating and driving forward the various project phases.
